definition: שֵׁאת noun feminine doubtful word; perhaps (for * שֶׁאֶת ) din of battle (= שָׁאוֺן ); Thes and others devastation , compare שְׁאִיָּה ; either meaning suits ׳ הַשּׁ Lam 3:47 (|| הַשָּׁ֑בֶר ; but We compare Hex. 2, 351 , from II. שׁוא , desolation ); contracted (according to Thes and most) שֵׁת , in בְּנֵי שֵׁת Num 24:17 ( J ) sons of (battle-) din (warriors, = שָׁאוֺןבְּנֵי in || Jer 48:45 ); Vrss take שֵׁת here as proper name; Gray proposes שֵׂת = שְׂאֵת , pride , or reading as Jeremiah compare We comp. Hex.351 .
